preconditions.description: The dimensions of the room must be between 1 and 50.
At least one dimension of the room must be even.

preconditions.expression: len(current_config) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in current_config)
preconditions.description: The current configuration must have n rows and m columns.

preconditions.expression: len(desired_config) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in desired_config)
preconditions.description: The desired configuration must have n rows and m columns.

postconditions.description: The output must either be -1 indicating impossibility or a valid number of operations within the limit.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= op[0] <= n and 1 <= op[1] <= m for op in operations)
postconditions.description: All operations must specify valid coordinates within the room dimensions.
After performing the operations, the current configuration must match the desired configuration.
